result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The main visible defect is the empty profile/account avatar in the top right, which shows only a red dot on a blank grey circle. A few minor styling and accessibility concerns also appear. Carousel clipping and the partially visible bottom card are expected and not reported.

issues.description: The circular button at the top right is an empty grey circle with only a small red dot. It has no icon, avatar or initials, so its purpose is unclear. It looks like an icon or image that failed to load, and the red dot has no clear meaning (notification badge?).
issues.suggestion: Render a clear icon (profile, bell or cart) or a user avatar inside the circle. Position the badge on the icon's corner and make sure the asset loads.

issues.description: The delivery-time pills (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the bottom-left of the images. The white pill on the light Green Bowl Poké image has weak separation from the background, and the pill sits over the plate edge.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or border to the pills, or inset them consistently so they do not collide with the image subject.

issues.description: The secondary grey text (delivery fees, the search placeholder, the '(500+)' rating count, inactive nav labels) is light grey on white/light grey and has low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: The heart/favorite button is styled inconsistently across cards: on the ramen card it is a dark translucent circle that barely shows against the dark image, while the pizza card has a visibly different circle.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite-button style, such as a solid white circle with a dark heart, so it is visible on any image.
